top_deficiency_types.title: Add doors in an exit area that do not require the use of a key from the exit side unless in case of special locking arrangements.
Have a fire alarm with audible and visual signals that transmits the alarm automatically to notify emergency forces in event of fire.
Have generator or other power source capable of supplying service within 10 seconds.
top_deficiency_types.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure each resident’s drug regimen must be free from unnecessary drugs.
Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.
Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.
Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.
Provide appropriate pressure ulcer care and prevent new ulcers from developing.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Allow resident to participate in the development and implementation of his or her person-centered plan of care.
